mutations.name: a call inside one container draws a self arrow
kills: emitRepoMap protocol arrows on the whiteboard-shaped repo leaves a call inside one container, or to a file not on the map, off the container map

mutations.name: a call from a file off the map draws an arrow
kills: emitRepoMap protocol arrows on the whiteboard-shaped repo leaves a call inside one container, or to a file not on the map, off the container map

mutations.name: imports only is never labelled
kills: emitRepoMap protocol arrows on the whiteboard-shaped repo labels the container import arrows imports only when no protocol arrow is drawn

mutations.name: imports only labels every level
kills: emitRepoMap protocol arrows on the whiteboard-shaped repo labels the container import arrows imports only when no protocol arrow is drawn

mutations.name: a folded arrow shows only its first endpoint
kills: emitRepoMap protocol arrows on the whiteboard-shaped repo draws one labelled one-way arrow per caller and server container, folding several endpoints

mutations.name: a protocol arrow takes the import arrow's id
kills: emitRepoMap protocol arrows on the whiteboard-shaped repo routes every protocol arrow and gives it an id apart from the import arrow it may run beside

mutations.name: no protocol input labels imports only
kills: emitRepoMap protocol arrows on the whiteboard-shaped repo leaves import arrows unlabelled when protocol arrows are drawn, and the map unchanged with no protocol input

mutations.name: label kinds follow input order
kills: emitRepoMap protocol arrows on the whiteboard-shaped repo gives the same map whatever order the protocol edges arrive in
